Decision reference missing: Linear state machine (C1) enforces strict stage ordering with no parallelism; only one stage is active at any time, maximizing determinism and auditability.
Decision reference missing: Big-bang milestone strategy: all deliverables converge into a single freeze event; no partial freezes or incremental releases.

Decision reference missing: High HITL strictness: every escalation trigger (ChangeRequest, forbidden-path access, secrets detection, retry budget exhaustion, waiver requests, tool permission expansion) requires human approval before proceeding.

Decision reference missing: Workspace Gateway (C2) is the sole API for all artifact and workspace IO, enforcing canonical/non-canonical separation, versioning, secrets scanning, and checkpoint/restore at every stage boundary.

Decision reference missing: Context packs are compiled by the orchestrator (C1) at each stage boundary using deterministic selection rules with explicit byte/token bounds, ensuring bounded and reproducible context delivery.

Decision reference missing: Repair loops (C8 → C6) are bounded by orchestrator-enforced iteration caps and operation caps; smallest-passing-repair selection uses deterministic tie-breakers (fewest ops → fewest bytes → first-generated).
Decision reference missing: Reviewer Pod (C7) is findings-only with no write permissions; Judge Pod (C9) is decisions-only with no patch authoring; multi-vendor routing enforced by orchestrator.
Decision reference missing: Secrets scanning runs at every checkpoint boundary and before freeze; any detection blocks persistence and triggers HITL.
